def pstate():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:

print("start:", pstate())
for mv in ['UP','RIGHT','DOWN','LEFT']:
    action([mv])
    print("after", mv, ":", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), pstate())
